name: Geig's Orchard
tagline: Farm Store Goods: Apple Cider, Jams & Ohio
description: In Seville, OH, Geig's Orchard raises Apples and Pumpkins on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
